package aiprompt

import (
	"context"
	"encoding/json"
	"net/http"
	"net/http/httptest"
	"testing"

	studentuc "github.com/example/ms-student-service/internal/usecase/student"
)

func TestClientExecutesInternalPromptAndReturnsParsedResponse(t *testing.T) {
	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(responseWriter http.ResponseWriter, request *http.Request) {
		if request.URL.Path != "/api/v1/prompts/execute" || request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token") != "internal-token" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected AI prompt request: %s token=%q", request.URL.Path, request.Header.Get("X-Internal-Token"))
		}
		var payload map[string]any
		if err := json.NewDecoder(request.Body).Decode(&payload); err != nil {
			t.Fatalf("decode request: %v", err)
		}
		if payload["template_code"] != "practice_task.solution_review.v1" || payload["response_schema_code"] != "practice_task.review.v1" {
			t.Fatalf("unexpected prompt contract: %#v", payload)
		}
		responseWriter.Header().Set("Content-Type", "application/json")
		_, _ = responseWriter.Write([]byte(`{"parsed_response":{"decision":"pass","summary":"ok","findings":[],"evidence":[]}}`))
	}))
	defer server.Close()

	result, err := (Client{BaseURL: server.URL, InternalToken: "internal-token"}).Execute(context.Background(), studentuc.PracticeTaskAIReviewRequest{
		TemplateCode:       "practice_task.solution_review.v1",
		LanguageCode:       "ru",
		ResponseSchemaCode: "practice_task.review.v1",
		Variables:          map[string]any{"practice_task": map[string]any{"title": "Marketplace"}},
	})
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("execute prompt: %v", err)
	}
	if string(result) != `{"decision":"pass","summary":"ok","findings":[],"evidence":[]}` {
		t.Fatalf("unexpected parsed response: %s", result)
	}
}
